style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontColor=#8c8f98;fontSize=11;fontFamily=IBM Plex Sans;spacing=0;" value="Temporal owns the workflow and the task backlog. For each task the scheduler reads pool capacity (node allocatable minus pod requests) and answers with a task queue and priority class, nothing more. Each pool has its own Temporal task queue served by long-lived slot worker pods, each carrying a worker build id for versioned workflow code. Pods heartbeat with a checkpoint reference, and cancel arrives on the heartbeat reply. Checkpoints go to object storage so a task can resume. An OOM kill shows as exit code 137 plus a node event and counts as a task failure." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="920" x="20" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Temporal owns the workflow and the task backlog. For each task the scheduler reads pool capacity (node allocatable minus pod requests) and answers with a task queue and priority class, nothing more. Each pool has its own Temporal task queue served by long-lived slot worker pods, each carrying a worker build id for versioned workflow code. Pods heartbeat with a checkpoint reference, and cancel arrives on the heartbeat reply. Checkpoints go to object storage so a task can resume. An OOM kill shows as exit code 137 plus a node event and counts as a task failure.
